name: Scope & Serial Monitor
description: Visual serial line triggers → scope stop → instrument.capture + waveform_source → PDF. Writes under projects/{project}/tests/{test_id}/runs/{stamp}/ where test_id is the sanitized report name (file_prefix).

params.name: file_prefix
params.label: Report name / prefix
params.help: Report name. Default is plugin.json report_name. Sanitized value is tests/{test_id}/ and the prefix for ISF, PDF, PNG, and summary Markdown.

params.name: port
params.label: Serial port
params.help_zh: 选择接收设备日志的串口。

params.name: baud
params.label: Baud
params.help_zh: 与设备的串口速率保持一致。

params.name: prefer_device_id
params.label: Instrument
params.help: Pick a connected instrument, or leave Auto and click Preflight to fill from the live list.
params.help_zh: 选择已连接的示波器；只有一台时，可直接使用自动选择。

params.name: triggers
params.label: Line triggers
params.help: Add rules, choose Contains text or Regular expression, and enter match text. Advanced options contain names, exclusions and regex flags.
params.help_zh: 点击添加条件，填写关键词即可。多个条件任一命中即可抓取；同一行按顺序只触发一次。复杂匹配和忽略条件在更多设置中调整。

params.name: scope_kind
params.label: Instrument kind
params.help: Filters the instrument picker. Changing kind does not require Hub code changes.
params.help_zh: 通常保持示波器；特殊仪器请在此调整。

params.name: scope_model
params.label: Model
params.help: Optional. Empty = accept any model of this kind. Preflight fills from *IDN?.
params.help_zh: 选填。留空接受已选类型的任意型号，预检可自动识别。

params.name: scope_resource
params.label: VISA resource
params.help: Optional. Empty = use the connected device. Used to reconnect if the session dropped.
params.help_zh: 选填。用于指定设备地址和掉线重连；通常保持自动。

params.name: isf_dir
params.label: ISF directory
params.help: Must stay under this run's artifacts. Default: {artifacts_dir}/waves

params.name: product
params.label: Product
params.help: Shown in the report body only. Folder tree uses project / file_prefix / stamp, not {product}.
params.help_zh: 选填，仅显示在报告正文中。

params.name: rising_edge
params.label: Capture once for consecutive matches
params.label_zh: 连续相同消息只抓取一次
params.help: Capture on the first matching line; a nonmatching line rearms this rule. Off = capture on every matching line.
params.help_zh: 避免同一段连续消息反复抓取；出现不匹配的消息后可再次抓取。

params.name: preflight_only
params.label: Preflight only
params.help: CLI compat: --preflight_only true. Hub uses the Preflight button (--lifecycle preflight).
